name: rekt-ui
description: Rekt UI: the website, the API and the rektui CLI

scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix packages/cli install
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.check:api: npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/api run test:e2e && npm --prefix apps/api run build
scripts.check:cli: npm --prefix packages/cli run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/cli test
scripts.check: npm run check:web && npm run check:api && npm run check:cli
